policy: Original explanations, Uzbek translations and examples. References support grammatical facts; their dictionary wording and examples are not copied. Usage frames are labelled separately from lexical collocations. Personal names have no interchangeable synonyms.

entries.definitionEn: Away from the place where someone or something was before.
entries.translationUz: ketgan; avvalgi joyida yo‘q
entries.exampleEn: When Mia checked the cage, the hamster was gone.
entries.exampleUz: Mia qafasni tekshirganda, xomyak u yerda yo‘q edi.

entries.definitionEn: At an earlier time than the event or time named after this word.
entries.translationUz: ...dan oldin; ...dan avval
entries.exampleEn: We packed our bags before breakfast.
entries.exampleUz: Biz nonushtadan oldin sumkalarimizni tayyorladik.

entries.definitionEn: Introduces a clause describing an event that happens later than the main event.
entries.translationUz: ...ishidan oldin; ...masidan avval
entries.exampleEn: Check the door before you leave.
entries.exampleUz: Ketishingizdan oldin eshikni tekshiring.

entries.definitionEn: At a later time than the event or time named after this word.
entries.translationUz: ...dan keyin; ...dan so‘ng
entries.exampleEn: Sara went home after school.
entries.exampleUz: Sara darslardan keyin uyiga ketdi.

entries.definitionEn: Introduces a clause describing an earlier event, with the main event happening later.
entries.translationUz: ...ganidan keyin; ...gach
entries.exampleEn: His mother found the bag after he left.
entries.exampleUz: Onasi u ketganidan keyin sumkani topdi.

entries.definitionEn: A short distance from the person, place or thing named after this word.
entries.translationUz: ...ga yaqin; ...ning yaqinida
entries.exampleEn: The farm is near the river.
entries.exampleUz: Ferma daryoning yaqinida.

entries.definitionEn: At the back of the person, place or thing named after this word.
entries.translationUz: ...ning orqasida; ...ning ortida
entries.exampleEn: The hamster was behind the wardrobe.
entries.exampleUz: Xomyak kiyim javonining orqasida edi.

entries.definitionEn: A time expression placing an event thirty minutes after the hour that follows.
entries.translationUz: soat ... yarim; aytilgan soatdan o‘ttiz daqiqa o‘tgan vaqt
entries.exampleEn: The lesson starts at half past eight.
entries.exampleUz: Dars soat sakkiz yarimda boshlanadi.

entries.definitionEn: A male given name, also used as a short form of Thomas.
entries.translationUz: Tom — erkak kishining ismi
entries.exampleEn: Tom packed his lunch for the trip.
entries.exampleUz: Tom sayohat uchun tushligini tayyorladi.

entries.definitionEn: A personal name used for a girl or woman.
entries.translationUz: Sara — qiz yoki ayol kishining ismi
entries.exampleEn: Sara checked her alarm clock.
entries.exampleUz: Sara uyg‘otkich soatini tekshirdi.

entries.definitionEn: A personal name used for a girl or woman.
entries.translationUz: Mia — qiz yoki ayol kishining ismi
entries.exampleEn: Mia put her hamster back in its cage.
entries.exampleUz: Mia xomyagini qafasiga qaytardi.

entries.definitionEn: By passing within an opening or space from one side to the other.
entries.translationUz: ... orqali; ... ichidan o‘tib
entries.exampleEn: Cold air entered through a gap in the door.
entries.exampleUz: Eshikdagi tirqish orqali sovuq havo kirdi.

entries.definitionEn: In a position lower than the object named, often directly beneath it.
entries.translationUz: ... tagida; ... ostida
entries.exampleEn: The puppy slept under my chair.
entries.exampleUz: Kuchukcha stulimning tagida uxladi.

entries.definitionEn: Extending from one side of a space or surface to another.

entries.definitionEn: Within the space enclosed by the object or place named.
entries.translationUz: ... ichida
entries.exampleEn: The spare keys were inside a red box.

entries.definitionEn: At a position higher than the object or level named.

entries.exampleEn: A small bird flew above the roof.

entries.definitionEn: Marks the time up to which an action or situation continues.

entries.translationUz: ekran surati; skrinshot
entries.exampleEn: The administrator kept a screenshot of the old message.
entries.exampleUz: Administrator eski xabarning ekran suratini saqladi.

entries.definitionEn: A collection of related data organised for use together, for example in an analysis.
entries.translationUz: ma’lumotlar to‘plami
entries.exampleEn: Iris requested the original dataset behind the graph.
entries.exampleUz: Iris grafik asosidagi dastlabki ma’lumotlar to‘plamini so‘radi.

entries.definitionEn: Not one and not the other of two people or things.
entries.translationUz: ikkalasidan hech biri
entries.exampleEn: Two studies used the same dataset, but neither explained the graph.
entries.exampleUz: Ikkita tadqiqot bir xil ma’lumotlar to‘plamidan foydalandi, ammo ularning hech biri grafikni izohlamadi.

entries.definitionEn: The person responsible for leading and managing a school.
entries.translationUz: maktab direktori
entries.exampleEn: The headteacher asked whether families had received the correction.
entries.exampleUz: Maktab direktori oilalardan tuzatilgan xabarni olgan-olmaganini so‘radi.

entries.definitionEn: In the direction of the person, place or thing named.
entries.translationUz: ... tomon; ...ga qarab
entries.exampleEn: The technician moved the camera toward the riverbed.
entries.exampleUz: Texnik kamerani daryo tubi tomon siljitdi.

entries.definitionEn: The part of an email or messaging service where received messages are listed.
entries.translationUz: kiruvchi xabarlar qutisi
entries.exampleEn: The workers kept checking their inboxes at home.
entries.exampleUz: Xodimlar uyida ham kiruvchi xabarlar qutisini tekshirishda davom etdi.

entries.definitionEn: To adjust a measuring device again so that its readings are accurate.
entries.translationUz: o‘lchov moslamasini to‘g‘ri ko‘rsatish uchun qayta sozlamoq
entries.exampleEn: The technician recalibrated the lift’s weight sensor.
entries.exampleUz: Texnik liftning og‘irlik datchigini to‘g‘ri ko‘rsatish uchun qayta sozladi.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with the colour of something.
entries.translationUz: rang bilan bog‘liq
entries.exampleEn: Colour-related returns fell after the new photographs were added.
entries.exampleUz: Yangi suratlar qo‘shilgach, mahsulotni rangi sabab qaytarish holatlari kamaydi.

entries.definitionEn: Connected with paying after the required date.
entries.translationUz: to‘lovni kechiktirish bilan bog‘liq
entries.exampleEn: Late-payment charges were paused during the investigation.
entries.exampleUz: Tekshiruv paytida to‘lovni kechiktirish uchun olinadigan qo‘shimcha haq to‘xtatib turildi.

entries.definitionEn: Involving all the members or sections of an orchestra together.
entries.translationUz: butun orkestr ishtirokidagi
entries.exampleEn: The players requested a full-orchestra rehearsal.
entries.exampleUz: Musiqachilar butun orkestr bilan repetitsiya qilishni so‘radi.

entries.definitionEn: Concerning or affecting every pupil in a class.
entries.translationUz: butun sinfga oid; sinfdagi barcha o‘quvchilarni qamrab oladigan
entries.exampleEn: Class-wide alerts needed an extra staff check.
entries.exampleUz: Butun sinfga oid ogohlantirishlar xodimning qo‘shimcha tekshiruvini talab qildi.

entries.definitionEn: A written message displayed to give information or instructions.
entries.translationUz: yozma e’lon; ma’lumot yoki ko‘rsatma yozilgan xabar
entries.exampleEn: The notice asked visitors to keep away from the nests.
entries.exampleUz: Yozma e’londa tashrif buyuruvchilardan uyalarga yaqinlashmaslik so‘ralgan edi.

entries.definitionEn: The act of sending a purchased product back to the seller, for example because it is unsuitable.
entries.translationUz: xarid qilingan mahsulotni sotuvchiga qaytarish
entries.exampleEn: The shop recorded every return request separately.
entries.exampleUz: Do‘kon mahsulotni qaytarish haqidagi har bir so‘rovni alohida qayd etdi.

entries.definitionEn: A purchased product sent back to the seller because the buyer does not want or cannot use it.
entries.translationUz: sotuvchiga qaytarilgan mahsulot
entries.exampleEn: The returns team checked the colour of each chair.
entries.exampleUz: Qaytarilgan mahsulotlar bilan ishlovchi guruh har bir stulning rangini tekshirdi.

entries.definitionEn: Introduces a fact that contrasts strongly with what the main clause says.
entries.translationUz: ... bo‘lsa ham; ...ga qaramay
entries.exampleEn: The chair was returned even though it was comfortable.
entries.exampleUz: Stul qulay bo‘lsa ham, uni sotuvchiga qaytarishdi.
usageFrames: even though the result was positive

entries.definitionEn: A customer's written opinion or rating of a product or service they have used.
entries.translationUz: xaridorning mahsulot yoki xizmat haqidagi fikri va bahosi
entries.exampleEn: The customer wrote a positive review of the chair.
entries.exampleUz: Xaridor stul haqida ijobiy fikr va baho yozdi.

entries.definitionEn: A selected value or option that controls how a device or program operates.
entries.translationUz: qurilma yoki dastur sozlamasi
entries.exampleEn: The screen settings changed the appearance of the photograph.
entries.exampleUz: Ekran sozlamalari suratning ko‘rinishini o‘zgartirdi.

entries.definitionEn: A collection of related pages available on the internet under a common address.
entries.translationUz: veb-sayt; umumiy manzildagi internet sahifalari to‘plami
entries.exampleEn: The website showed the chair in natural daylight.
entries.exampleUz: Veb-saytda stul tabiiy kunduzgi yorug‘likda ko‘rsatilgan edi.

entries.definitionEn: With the conditions or circumstances named applying at the time.
entries.translationUz: ... sharoitida; ... ta’sirida
entries.exampleEn: The fabric looked different under warm lighting.
entries.exampleUz: Mato iliq tusli yorug‘lik ta’sirida boshqacha ko‘rindi.

entries.definitionEn: Outside the limits of a person's or organisation's power, ability or control.
entries.translationUz: ... imkoniyati yoki nazorati doirasidan tashqarida
entries.exampleEn: The colour settings on customers' screens were beyond the retailer's control.
entries.exampleUz: Xaridorlar ekranidagi rang sozlamalari sotuvchining nazorat doirasidan tashqarida edi.

entries.definitionEn: Multiplied by the number stated, when comparing quantities.
entries.translationUz: ... baravar; ... marta ko‘p
entries.exampleEn: The bill showed three times the usual electricity use.
entries.exampleUz: Hisobda odatdagidan uch baravar ko‘p elektr sarfi ko‘rsatilgan edi.
usageFrames: twice the amount, or two times the amount

entries.definitionEn: Together with or in addition to the person or thing named.
entries.translationUz: ... bilan birga; ...ga qo‘shimcha ravishda
entries.exampleEn: Javed uploaded the document along with the photographs.
entries.exampleUz: Javed hujjatni suratlar bilan birga yukladi.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plays a musical instrument, whether professionally or as an amateur.
entries.translationUz: musiqa asbobida chaladigan kishi; sozanda
entries.exampleEn: The young players asked for a full-orchestra rehearsal.
entries.exampleUz: Yosh sozandalar butun orkestr bilan repetitsiya qilishni so‘radi.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plays a musical instrument or creates music, especially with skill.
entries.translationUz: musiqachi; musiqa ijro etadigan yoki yaratadigan kishi
entries.exampleEn: One musician asked the conductor for more practice together.
entries.exampleUz: Bir musiqachi dirijyordan birga ko‘proq mashq qilishni so‘radi.

entries.definitionEn: To return to a normal or effective condition after a difficulty or disruption.
entries.translationUz: qiyinchilikdan keyin o‘zini o‘nglab olmoq; odatdagi holatga qaytmoq
entries.exampleEn: The players recovered quickly after missing the conductor's cue.
entries.exampleUz: Sozandalar dirijyorning ishorasini o‘tkazib yuborgach, tezda o‘zlarini o‘nglab oldi.

entries.definitionEn: One or the other of the two people or things being considered.
entries.translationUz: ikkalasidan biri; u yoki bu
entries.exampleEn: Neither rehearsal method was sufficient on its own, but either method could help.
entries.exampleUz: Repetitsiyaning hech qaysi usuli yolg‘iz o‘zi yetarli emas edi, ammo ikkalasidan biri ham foyda berishi mumkin edi.

entries.definitionEn: A situation in which water covers land or buildings that are normally dry.
entries.translationUz: suv bosishi; toshqin oqibatida suv ostida qolish
entries.exampleEn: The photograph showed flooding from five years earlier.
entries.exampleUz: Suratda besh yil oldingi suv bosish holati ko‘rsatilgan edi.

entries.definitionEn: A person who manages an online group or service and controls its content or access.
entries.translationUz: onlayn guruh yoki xizmat boshqaruvchisi; administrator
entries.exampleEn: The group administrator removed the misleading photograph.
entries.exampleUz: Guruh administratori chalg‘ituvchi suratni olib tashladi.

entries.definitionEn: To provide an electronic connection that lets someone open another internet page or resource.
entries.translationUz: internet havolasi orqali bog‘lamoq; boshqa sahifaga havola bermoq
entries.exampleEn: The correction linked readers to the hospital's current notice.
entries.exampleUz: Tuzatish xabari o‘quvchilarni havola orqali shifoxonaning amaldagi e’loniga olib bordi.
usageFrames: link readers to the original source

entries.definitionEn: By using the person, organisation, channel or method named.
entries.translationUz: ... orqali; ... vositasida
entries.exampleEn: The photograph spread through a local message group.
entries.exampleUz: Surat mahalliy xabar almashish guruhi orqali tarqaldi.

entries.definitionEn: A short computer program containing instructions for carrying out a task.
entries.translationUz: kompyuter vazifasini bajaradigan buyruqlar ketma-ketligi; skript
entries.exampleEn: The author sent a script that recreated the graph.
entries.exampleUz: Muallif grafikni qayta yaratadigan skriptni yubordi.

entries.definitionEn: An electronic document with rows and columns used to organise data and calculate values.
entries.translationUz: ma’lumotlarni tartiblash va hisoblash uchun elektron jadval hujjati
entries.exampleEn: The spreadsheet contained the values used in the graph.
entries.exampleUz: Elektron jadvalda grafikda ishlatilgan qiymatlar bor edi.

entries.definitionEn: The person who wrote a particular book, article, report or other written work.
entries.translationUz: yozma asarning muallifi; kitob, maqola yoki hisobotni yozgan kishi
entries.exampleEn: The author of the article supplied the original data.
entries.exampleUz: Maqola muallifi dastlabki ma’lumotlarni taqdim etdi.

entries.definitionEn: As a necessary result, without requiring another condition or decision.
entries.translationUz: o‘z-o‘zidan; qo‘shimcha shartsiz zarur natija sifatida
entries.exampleEn: A similar graph does not automatically prove that the data were copied.
entries.exampleUz: Grafikning o‘xshashligi ma’lumotlar ko‘chirilganini o‘z-o‘zidan isbotlamaydi.

entries.definitionEn: Using or being described by the name, title, heading or label stated.
entries.translationUz: ... nomi yoki sarlavhasi ostida; ... deb belgilangan holda
entries.exampleEn: The articles displayed the same graph under different labels.
entries.exampleUz: Maqolalarda ayni grafik turli nomlar ostida ko‘rsatilgan edi.

entries.definitionEn: An opinion or decision reached after considering the available information.
entries.translationUz: o‘rganib chiqilgach bildirilgan fikr yoki yakuniy xulosa
entries.exampleEn: The museum asked a question instead of giving a final verdict about the bowls.
entries.exampleUz: Muzey kosalar haqida yakuniy xulosa berish o‘rniga savol qo‘ydi.
usageFrames: give a verdict on the evidence

entries.definitionEn: To produce or provide the result, benefit or outcome expected.
entries.translationUz: kutilgan natija yoki foydani bermoq; ta’minlamoq
entries.exampleEn: A careful museum display does not always deliver certainty.
entries.exampleUz: Puxta tayyorlangan muzey ko‘rgazmasi har doim ham qat’iy ishonch hosil qildirmaydi.

entries.definitionEn: The credibility or influence gained because someone is regarded as knowledgeable and reliable.
entries.translationUz: bilim va ishonchlilikka asoslangan nufuz; mutaxassis sifatidagi obro‘
entries.exampleEn: Visitors should examine the evidence rather than rely only on the museum's authority.
entries.exampleUz: Tashrif buyuruvchilar faqat muzeyning nufuziga tayanmay, dalillarni ham tekshirishi kerak.
usageFrames: speak with authority on a subject

entries.definitionEn: To be closely connected with a particular event, question or situation.
entries.translationUz: muayyan voqea, masala yoki holat bilan bog‘liq bo‘lmoq
entries.exampleEn: The label explained the uncertainty surrounding the bowls' possible uses.
entries.exampleUz: Izoh kosalarning ehtimoliy ishlatilish maqsadlari bilan bog‘liq noaniqlikni tushuntirdi.

entries.definitionEn: To have a label, mark, message or similar information attached to or displayed on something.
entries.translationUz: yorliq, belgi yoki yozuvga ega bo‘lmoq; ustida ... bo‘lmoq
entries.exampleEn: The bowls carried labels describing them as cooking pots.
entries.exampleUz: Kosalarda ularni ovqat pishirish idishlari deb ta’riflovchi yorliqlar bor edi.

entries.definitionEn: A school that provides education after primary school and before college or university.
entries.translationUz: boshlang‘ich ta’limdan keyingi bosqichdagi maktab; o‘rta maktab
entries.exampleEn: The secondary school sent attendance alerts to families.
entries.exampleUz: O‘rta maktab oilalarga davomat haqidagi ogohlantirishlarni yubordi.

entries.definitionEn: The process of recording a person's presence or other details in an official list or system.
entries.translationUz: davomat yoki boshqa ma’lumotlarni rasmiy ro‘yxat yoki tizimga qayd etish
entries.exampleEn: The teacher corrected the registration code for the exam hall.
entries.exampleUz: O‘qituvchi imtihon zalining ro‘yxatga olish kodini tuzatdi.

entries.definitionEn: A computer screen or page that presents important data and status information together.
entries.translationUz: muhim ma’lumotlar va holatni bir joyda ko‘rsatadigan boshqaruv oynasi
entries.exampleEn: The dashboard showed that the messages had been sent.
entries.exampleUz: Boshqaruv oynasi xabarlar yuborilganini ko‘rsatdi.

entries.definitionEn: A message or alert sent to tell someone that something has happened or needs attention.
entries.translationUz: biror voqea yoki e’tibor talab qiladigan holat haqida yuborilgan bildirishnoma
entries.exampleEn: Receiving a notification did not prove that the parent understood it.
entries.exampleUz: Bildirishnomani olish ota-ona uni tushunganini isbotlamas edi.

entries.definitionEn: A requirement or necessity for something or for an action to be done.
entries.translationUz: zarurat; ehtiyoj; biror ishni qilish zarurligi
entries.exampleEn: The school balanced the need to inform families with the risk of sending incorrect alerts.
entries.exampleUz: Maktab oilalarni xabardor qilish zarurati bilan xato ogohlantirish yuborish xavfi o‘rtasida muvozanat saqladi.

entries.definitionEn: To record something as an image, video or sound so that it can be seen or heard again.
entries.translationUz: tasvir, video yoki ovoz ko‘rinishida qayd etmoq; kameraga olmoq
entries.exampleEn: The camera captured the larger fish but missed the smaller ones.
entries.exampleUz: Kamera yirikroq baliqlarni tasvirga oldi, ammo kichikroqlarini qayd etmadi.

entries.definitionEn: Clear enough in meaning for someone to understand.
entries.translationUz: mazmuni tushunarli; tushunish mumkin bo‘lgan
entries.exampleEn: The report made the limits of the camera method intelligible.
entries.exampleUz: Hisobot kamera usulining cheklovlarini tushunarli qilib izohladi.

entries.definitionEn: In the different groups, places, periods or situations within the range named.
entries.translationUz: ko‘rsatilgan turli guruhlar, davrlar yoki holatlar bo‘ylab; ularning barchasida
entries.exampleEn: The researchers checked whether the estimates stayed reliable across different seasons.
entries.exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar taxminiy hisoblar turli fasllarda ham ishonchli qolishini tekshirdi.

entries.definitionEn: Important details printed in smaller or less noticeable text, often containing conditions or qualifications.
entries.translationUz: mayda yozuvdagi muhim tafsilotlar, shartlar yoki cheklovlar
entries.exampleEn: The report explained its limitations clearly instead of hiding them in small print.
entries.exampleUz: Hisobot cheklovlarni mayda yozuvga yashirmay, aniq tushuntirdi.

entries.definitionEn: A place on a railway where trains stop so that passengers can get on or off.
entries.translationUz: temiryo‘l vokzali yoki bekati; yo‘lovchilar poyezdga chiqadigan va tushadigan joy
entries.exampleEn: The restaurant stood inside a busy railway station.
entries.exampleUz: Restoran gavjum temiryo‘l vokzali ichida joylashgan edi.

entries.definitionEn: Without allowing the fact or condition named to change what happens.
entries.translationUz: ...dan qat’i nazar; ...ni hisobga olmagan holda
entries.exampleEn: The kitchen prepared the same amount regardless of how busy the station was.
entries.exampleUz: Oshxona vokzal qanchalik gavjumligidan qat’i nazar, bir xil miqdorda taom tayyorlar edi.
usageFrames: regardless of whether it is busy

entries.definitionEn: Introduces a fact that contrasts with the main statement, meaning although.
entries.translationUz: ... bo‘lsa ham; garchi
entries.exampleEn: Waste fell, though the restaurant had also had fewer customers.
entries.exampleUz: Chiqindi kamaydi, garchi restoranga kelgan mijozlar ham kamroq bo‘lgan bo‘lsa-da.

entries.definitionEn: Together with another item, so that both are included or considered.
entries.translationUz: ... bilan birga; taqqoslash uchun ... bilan yonma-yon
entries.exampleEn: Staff recorded food waste alongside the number of meals sold.
entries.exampleUz: Xodimlar ovqat chiqindisini sotilgan taomlar soni bilan birga qayd etdi.
usageFrames: consider the result alongside other evidence

entries.definitionEn: To show that an established belief or assumption is wrong and should be rejected.
entries.translationUz: mavjud qarash yoki taxminning noto‘g‘riligini ko‘rsatib, uni rad etmoq
entries.exampleEn: The measurements overturned the assumption that diners caused most of the waste.
entries.exampleUz: O‘lchovlar chiqindining ko‘piga mijozlar sabab bo‘ladi degan taxminni rad etdi.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that other people do not readily notice.
entries.translationUz: sezilmasdan; ko‘pchilikning e’tiborini tortmagan holda
entries.exampleEn: Remote working had quietly extended the working day.
entries.exampleUz: Masofadan ishlash ish kunini sezilmasdan uzaytirib yuborgan edi.

entries.definitionEn: An investigation that collects people's answers to questions about their experiences or opinions.
entries.translationUz: so‘rov; odamlarning tajribasi yoki fikrini savollar orqali o‘rganish
entries.exampleEn: A staff survey identified evening messages as a source of stress.
entries.exampleUz: Xodimlar so‘rovi kechki xabarlar ruhiy bosim manbai ekanini ko‘rsatdi.

entries.definitionEn: A senior person responsible for running an organization or one of its departments.
entries.translationUz: direktor; tashkilot yoki bo‘limni boshqaradigan rahbar
entries.exampleEn: The director agreed to review the company's messaging policy.
entries.exampleUz: Direktor kompaniyaning xabar almashish qoidasini qayta ko‘rib chiqishga rozi bo‘ldi.

entries.definitionEn: A region whose clocks follow the same standard local time.
entries.translationUz: vaqt mintaqasi; bir xil mahalliy vaqt amal qiladigan hudud
entries.exampleEn: Colleagues in different time zones agreed on shared working hours.
entries.exampleUz: Turli vaqt mintaqalaridagi hamkasblar birgalikda ishlash vaqtini kelishib oldi.

entries.definitionEn: Introduces a condition that must be met for the main statement to apply.
entries.translationUz: ... sharti bilan; agar ... bo‘lsa
entries.exampleEn: Teams could choose their hours, provided everyone understood the urgent channel.
entries.exampleUz: Hamma shoshilinch aloqa kanalini tushunishi sharti bilan, jamoalar ish vaqtini tanlashi mumkin edi.

entries.definitionEn: A sound or on-screen notice that draws attention to a new message or event.
entries.translationUz: bildirishnoma; yangi xabar yoki hodisa kelganini bildiradigan signal
entries.exampleEn: Incoming alerts interrupted employees during dinner.
entries.exampleUz: Kiruvchi bildirishnomalar xodimlarni kechki ovqat paytida chalg‘itar edi.

entries.definitionEn: A belief about the standard of behaviour or performance that someone ought to meet.
entries.translationUz: kutiladigan talab; kimdir qanday ishlashi yoki o‘zini tutishi kerakligi haqidagi tasavvur
entries.exampleEn: Employees felt pressure from their own expectations of constant availability.
entries.exampleUz: Xodimlar doim aloqada bo‘lish kerak degan o‘z talablaridan bosim his qilardi.

entries.definitionEn: Used to compare someone or something with a similar person, thing, or situation.
entries.translationUz: ...ga o‘xshab; ...dek; ...kabi
entries.exampleEn: A delayed reply no longer felt like a professional failure.
entries.exampleUz: Kechikkan javob endi kasbiy muvaffaqiyatsizlikdek tuyulmas edi.

entries.definitionEn: The period between receiving a request or message and responding to it.
entries.translationUz: javob berish muddati; so‘rov yoki xabar kelganidan unga javob berilguncha o‘tadigan vaqt
entries.exampleEn: Managers stated realistic response times for routine messages.
entries.exampleUz: Rahbarlar oddiy xabarlarga javob berish uchun maqbul muddatlarni belgiladi.

entries.definitionEn: To meet the required standard in a test or inspection.
entries.translationUz: sinov yoki tekshiruvdan muvaffaqiyatli o‘tmoq; talabga javob bermoq
entries.exampleEn: The lift passed the supervised safety trials.
entries.exampleUz: Lift nazorat ostidagi xavfsizlik sinovlaridan muvaffaqiyatli o‘tdi.

entries.definitionEn: With only a small interval of time before or after the event mentioned.
entries.translationUz: sal oldin yoki ko‘p o‘tmay; qisqa vaqt farqi bilan
entries.exampleEn: The lift stopped shortly after heavy objects were loaded.
entries.exampleUz: Og‘ir buyumlar yuklanganidan ko‘p o‘tmay lift to‘xtadi.

entries.definitionEn: The words and expressions chosen to communicate something, including their style or tone.
entries.translationUz: ifoda usuli; fikrni bildirish uchun tanlangan so‘z va iboralar
entries.exampleEn: Reassuring language alone did not prove that the lift was safe.
entries.exampleUz: Faqat xotirjam qiluvchi iboralar lift xavfsizligini isbotlamas edi.

entries.definitionEn: A written or electronic record in which events, problems, or actions are entered in order.
entries.translationUz: qayd jurnali; voqea, muammo yoki bajarilgan ishlar ketma-ket yoziladigan qaydnoma
entries.exampleEn: Residents entered each lift fault in a central log.
entries.exampleUz: Aholi liftdagi har bir nosozlikni umumiy qayd jurnaliga yozdi.
usageFrames: enter a fault in the log

entries.definitionEn: By using the method, person, or communication channel named.
entries.translationUz: ... orqali; ... vositasida
entries.exampleEn: Residents reported faults through a shared maintenance log.
entries.exampleUz: Aholi nosozliklar haqida umumiy texnik qayd jurnali orqali xabar berdi.
usageFrames: report a fault through the system

entries.definitionEn: Previously owned or used by someone else before being sold or given to another person.
entries.translationUz: ishlatilgan; avval boshqa birovga tegishli bo‘lgan
entries.exampleEn: She found the film inside a second-hand camera.
entries.exampleUz: U plyonkani ishlatilgan fotoapparat ichidan topdi.

entries.definitionEn: Internet services through which people share posts, pictures, and messages with other users.
entries.translationUz: ijtimoiy tarmoqlar; foydalanuvchilar xabar va surat ulashadigan internet xizmatlari
entries.exampleEn: The photographer did not put the wedding pictures on social media.
entries.exampleUz: Fotograf to‘y suratlarini ijtimoiy tarmoqlarga joylamadi.
usageFrames: post a picture on social media

entries.definitionEn: Stored or represented as electronic data that a computer can process.
entries.translationUz: raqamli; kompyuterda qayta ishlash va saqlash mumkin bo‘lgan elektron shakldagi
entries.exampleEn: She gave the family digital copies of the photographs.
entries.exampleUz: U oilaga fotosuratlarning raqamli nusxalarini berdi.

entries.definitionEn: Away from or not included on the place, surface, or platform mentioned.
entries.translationUz: ...dan chetda; ...ga chiqarmasdan yoki joylamasdan
entries.exampleEn: She kept the private photographs off public websites.
entries.exampleUz: U shaxsiy fotosuratlarni ommaviy saytlarga joylamadi.
usageFrames: keep personal details off public pages

entries.definitionEn: Before the end of the period of time mentioned.
entries.translationUz: ... ichida; belgilangan muddat tugashidan oldin
entries.exampleEn: Complaints appeared within a week of the benches being installed.
entries.exampleUz: O‘rindiqlar o‘rnatilganidan keyin bir hafta ichida shikoyatlar kelib tushdi.

entries.definitionEn: A number or set of numbers showing the size, distance, or quantity that has been measured.
entries.translationUz: o‘lcham; o‘lchab aniqlangan kattalik, masofa yoki miqdor
entries.exampleEn: The measurements on the old map no longer matched the path.
entries.exampleUz: Eski xaritadagi o‘lchamlar endi yo‘lakka mos kelmas edi.

entries.definitionEn: A person who plans the layout and planting of outdoor spaces such as gardens or parks.
entries.translationUz: landshaft dizayneri; bog‘ va xiyobon kabi ochiq joylarning tuzilishi va o‘simliklarini rejalashtiruvchi mutaxassis
entries.exampleEn: The landscape designer asked wheelchair users to test the path.
entries.exampleUz: Landshaft dizayneri nogironlik aravachasidan foydalanuvchilardan yo‘lakni sinab ko‘rishni so‘radi.

entries.definitionEn: To represent the important or true features of something in a picture, description, or other record.
entries.translationUz: muhim yoki haqiqiy jihatlarni aniq aks ettirmoq
entries.exampleEn: A drawing cannot capture every obstacle people encounter on the path.
entries.exampleUz: Chizma odamlar yo‘lakda duch keladigan har bir to‘siqni aniq aks ettira olmaydi.

entries.definitionEn: A place where trains stop for passengers to get on or off.
entries.translationUz: vokzal yoki temiryo‘l bekati; poyezd yo‘lovchilari chiqib-tushadigan joy
entries.exampleEn: The station was quieter than usual at the weekend.
entries.exampleUz: Dam olish kunlari vokzal odatdagidan tinchroq edi.

entries.definitionEn: A computing method in which a system learns patterns from data to make predictions or decisions.
entries.translationUz: mashinaviy o‘rganish; kompyuterning ma’lumotlardagi qonuniyatlarni o‘rganib, bashorat yoki qaror chiqarishi
entries.exampleEn: The laboratory used machine learning to identify samples needing review.
entries.exampleUz: Laboratoriya qayta tekshirish kerak bo‘lgan namunalarni aniqlash uchun mashinaviy o‘rganishdan foydalandi.

entries.definitionEn: A computational structure with learned parameters that transforms input data into predictions or other outputs.
entries.translationUz: o‘rgatilgan kompyuter modeli; kiruvchi ma’lumotlardan bashorat yoki natija chiqaradigan tuzilma
entries.exampleEn: The model made more errors on images from the night scanner.
entries.exampleUz: Model tungi skanerdan olingan tasvirlarda ko‘proq xato qildi.

entries.definitionEn: The examples used to adjust the parameters of a machine-learning model.
entries.translationUz: modelni o‘rgatish ma’lumotlari; modelning ishlashini sozlash uchun beriladigan namunalar
entries.exampleEn: The training data contained too few images from the overnight scanner.
entries.exampleUz: O‘rgatish ma’lumotlarida tungi skanerdan olingan tasvirlar juda kam edi.
usageFrames: include examples in the training data

entries.definitionEn: A separate group of examples used to evaluate a trained model rather than to train it.
entries.translationUz: sinov ma’lumotlari to‘plami; o‘rgatishda ishlatilmagan, modelni baholash uchun ajratilgan namunalar
entries.exampleEn: The team reserved a fresh test set covering every work shift.
entries.exampleUz: Jamoa barcha ish smenalarini qamrab oladigan yangi sinov ma’lumotlari to‘plamini ajratdi.
usageFrames: evaluate predictions on the test set

entries.definitionEn: A way or procedure through which someone can achieve something or raise an issue.
entries.translationUz: yo‘l; biror maqsadga erishish yoki masalani ko‘tarish usuli
entries.exampleEn: Staff had a clear route for challenging the system's recommendations.
entries.exampleUz: Xodimlarda tizim tavsiyalariga e’tiroz bildirishning aniq yo‘li bor edi.

entries.definitionEn: Required to undergo the process or follow the condition mentioned.
entries.translationUz: ...dan o‘tishi shart bo‘lgan; ... talabiga bo‘ysunadigan
entries.exampleEn: The revised system remained subject to monthly error reviews.
entries.exampleUz: Yangilangan tizimdagi xatolarni har oy ko‘rib chiqish talabi saqlanib qoldi.

entries.definitionEn: Introduces a fact or opinion that contrasts with the one just mentioned.
entries.translationUz: ... esa; ... bo‘lsa; ikki holat yoki fikrni qarama-qarshi qo‘yuvchi bog‘lovchi
entries.exampleEn: The operator preferred barriers, whereas residents wanted quieter manoeuvres.
entries.exampleUz: Tashuvchi to‘siqlarni ma’qul ko‘rdi, aholi esa manevrlar tinchroq bo‘lishini xohladi.
usageFrames: one result fell, whereas another stayed the same

entries.definitionEn: With the named activity or requirement taken into account when arranging something.
entries.translationUz: ...ni hisobga olgan holda; reja tuzishda ...ga moslashtirib
entries.exampleEn: Freight movements were scheduled around passenger services.
entries.exampleUz: Yuk poyezdlari harakati yo‘lovchi qatnovlarini hisobga olgan holda rejalashtirildi.

entries.definitionEn: A regular transport operation or a scheduled journey made by a train, bus, or similar vehicle.
entries.translationUz: qatnov; poyezd, avtobus yoki boshqa transportning muntazam yoki jadvaldagi reysi
entries.exampleEn: Freight trains had to fit around the passenger services.
entries.exampleUz: Yuk poyezdlari yo‘lovchi qatnovlariga moslashtirilishi kerak edi.

entries.definitionEn: A separate vehicle forming part of a train and used to carry passengers or goods.
entries.translationUz: vagon; poyezd tarkibida yo‘lovchi yoki yuk tashiydigan alohida transport vositasi
entries.exampleEn: The workers changed the order in which the freight carriages were coupled.
entries.exampleUz: Ishchilar yuk vagonlarini bir-biriga ulash tartibini o‘zgartirdi.

entries.definitionEn: More or additional to what has already been mentioned or done.
entries.translationUz: yana; qo‘shimcha; avvalgisiga qo‘shiladigan
entries.exampleEn: The operator kept the quieter procedure for a further season.
entries.exampleUz: Tashuvchi tinchroq tartibni yana bir mavsum davomida saqladi.

entries.definitionEn: Sound that continues in the surrounding environment behind the main sound or event being considered.
entries.translationUz: fon shovqini; asosiy tovush yoki hodisaga qo‘shilib, atrofda davom etadigan shovqin
entries.exampleEn: The sharp impacts fell, but background noise from the railway remained.
entries.exampleUz: Keskin urilish tovushlari kamaydi, ammo temiryo‘lning fon shovqini saqlanib qoldi.

entries.definitionEn: To promise or accept an obligation to carry out a particular action.
entries.translationUz: va’da bermoq; muayyan ishni bajarish majburiyatini olmoq
entries.exampleEn: The council committed to publishing the monitoring locations.
entries.exampleUz: Kengash kuzatuv nuqtalarini e’lon qilish majburiyatini oldi.

entries.definitionEn: Able to be searched electronically to find particular items or information.
entries.translationUz: elektron qidiruv orqali topish yoki ichidan ma’lumot izlash mumkin bo‘lgan
entries.exampleEn: The archive made its catalogue searchable by date and location.
entries.exampleUz: Arxiv katalogini sana va joy bo‘yicha qidirish mumkin bo‘ldi.

entries.definitionEn: Showing relatively little fine detail in a digital image.
entries.translationUz: tasvir aniqligi past; mayda tafsilotlari kam ko‘rinadigan
entries.exampleEn: The archive supplied a lower-resolution copy to protect the people pictured.
entries.exampleUz: Arxiv suratdagi odamlarni himoya qilish uchun aniqligi pastroq nusxa berdi.

entries.definitionEn: To find a person or thing by investigating where they are.
entries.translationUz: izlab topmoq; surishtirib qayerdaligini aniqlamoq
entries.exampleEn: The archivists traced three people who appeared in the photograph.
entries.exampleUz: Arxivchilar suratda ko‘ringan uch kishini izlab topdi.
usageFrames: trace the owner of a photograph

entries.definitionEn: Familiar with something through repeated experience and accepting it as usual.
entries.translationUz: ko‘nikkan; qayta-qayta duch kelib odatlanib qolgan
entries.exampleEn: Researchers accustomed to instant downloads had to wait for supervised access.
entries.exampleUz: Darhol yuklab olishga ko‘nikkan tadqiqotchilar nazorat ostida foydalanish uchun kutishiga to‘g‘ri keldi.

entries.definitionEn: The act of receiving electronic data from another computer system over a network.
entries.translationUz: yuklab olish; boshqa kompyuter tizimidan tarmoq orqali ma’lumot olish jarayoni
entries.exampleEn: A slow connection delayed the download of the catalogue.
entries.exampleUz: Sekin ulanish katalogni yuklab olishni kechiktirdi.

entries.definitionEn: A file or group of files received from another computer system over a network.
entries.translationUz: yuklab olingan fayl yoki fayllar to‘plami
entries.exampleEn: The high-resolution download was available only to approved researchers.
entries.exampleUz: Aniqligi yuqori yuklab olinadigan fayl faqat ruxsat berilgan tadqiqotchilar uchun ochiq edi.

entries.definitionEn: Needing careful handling or limited disclosure because release could cause harm, embarrassment or offence.
entries.translationUz: ehtiyotkorlik bilan muomala qilish talab etiladigan; oshkor qilinishi zarar yoki noqulaylik keltirishi mumkin bo‘lgan
entries.exampleEn: The archive restricted access to sensitive photographs of living people.
entries.exampleUz: Arxiv tirik odamlar aks etgan nozik suratlarni ko‘rishni chekladi.

entries.definitionEn: The quality of information or material that requires careful handling because disclosure could harm or upset people.
entries.translationUz: ma’lumotning nozikligi; oshkor qilinsa zarar yoki noqulaylik tug‘dirishi mumkinligi
entries.exampleEn: The committee considered the sensitivity of the images before approving access.
entries.exampleUz: Qo‘mita foydalanishga ruxsat berishdan oldin suratlarning nozikligini hisobga oldi.

entries.definitionEn: A person who investigates a subject systematically to discover or establish facts.
entries.translationUz: tadqiqotchi; yangi faktlarni aniqlash yoki tekshirish uchun mavzuni izchil o‘rganuvchi kishi
entries.exampleEn: A history researcher compared the photographs with written records.
entries.exampleUz: Tarix tadqiqotchisi suratlarni yozma qaydlar bilan solishtirdi.

entries.definitionEn: A part that is missing from a body of information, knowledge or material.
entries.translationUz: bo‘shliq; ma’lumot yoki materialning yetishmayotgan qismi
entries.exampleEn: The catalogue explained the gaps left by redacted photographs.
entries.exampleUz: Katalog yashirilgan suratlar tufayli qolgan bo‘shliqlarni izohladi.

entries.definitionEn: Outside a stated boundary or extending farther than a named place or area.
entries.translationUz: ... doirasidan tashqarida; ...dan nariga yoki nariroqda
entries.exampleEn: The effects of publishing the images could extend beyond the university.
entries.exampleUz: Suratlarni e’lon qilish oqibatlari universitet doirasidan tashqariga ham yoyilishi mumkin edi.

entries.definitionEn: Having real importance, usefulness or practical effect.
entries.translationUz: amaliy ahamiyatga ega; sezilarli foyda yoki ta’siri bor
entries.exampleEn: Once the files were copied widely, the archive had little meaningful control over them.
entries.exampleUz: Fayllar keng ko‘chirilgach, arxiv ularni amalda deyarli nazorat qila olmadi.

entries.definitionEn: Used when describing a relationship or difference involving the things named.
entries.translationUz: ... o‘rtasida; ko‘rsatilgan narsalarning munosabati yoki farqini bildiradi
entries.exampleEn: The policy distinguished between supervised viewing and open publication.
entries.exampleUz: Siyosat nazorat ostida ko‘rish bilan ochiq e’lon qilish o‘rtasidagi farqni belgiladi.
usageFrames: the difference between access and publication

entries.definitionEn: Used to name the alternatives from which a choice is made.
entries.translationUz: ...dan birini; tanlovdagi muqobil imkoniyatlarni ko‘rsatadi
entries.exampleEn: The researchers had to choose between waiting and using a lower-resolution copy.
entries.exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar kutish yoki aniqligi pastroq nusxadan foydalanishdan birini tanlashi kerak edi.

entries.definitionEn: A cost that must be paid for something or for carrying out an activity.
entries.translationUz: xarajat; biror narsa yoki faoliyat uchun sarflanadigan mablag‘
entries.exampleEn: Heating was the greenhouse's largest winter expense.
entries.exampleUz: Isitish issiqxonaning qishdagi eng katta xarajati edi.

entries.definitionEn: The regular work needed to keep living plants healthy, such as watering, feeding and pruning.
entries.translationUz: o‘simliklarni parvarishlash; ularni sog‘lom saqlash uchun muntazam bajariladigan ishlar
entries.exampleEn: The report separated teaching costs from plant-maintenance costs.
entries.exampleUz: Hisobot o‘qitish xarajatlarini o‘simliklarni parvarishlash xarajatlaridan ajratdi.

entries.definitionEn: Based on relevant knowledge or reliable information.
entries.translationUz: ma’lumotga asoslangan; tegishli bilim yoki dalilga tayangan
entries.exampleEn: Separating the costs made a more informed argument possible.
entries.exampleUz: Xarajatlarni ajratish ko‘proq ma’lumotga asoslangan muhokama qilish imkonini berdi.

entries.definitionEn: To move a duty, responsibility or financial burden from one person or organisation to another.
entries.translationUz: boshqa shaxs yoki tashkilot zimmasiga o‘tkazmoq; mas’uliyat yoki xarajat yukini boshqaga yuklamoq
entries.exampleEn: The proposal transferred some costs to unpaid participants.
entries.exampleUz: Taklif ayrim xarajatlarni haq olmaydigan qatnashchilar zimmasiga yukladi.

entries.definitionEn: A name, code or piece of data used to distinguish a particular person or other entity.
entries.translationUz: identifikator; muayyan shaxs yoki narsani ajratib ko‘rsatadigan ism, kod yoki ma’lumot
entries.exampleEn: Removing a direct identifier did not eliminate every risk of recognising a patient.
entries.exampleUz: Bevosita identifikatorni olib tashlash bemorni tanib olishga doir barcha xavflarni yo‘qotmadi.

entries.definitionEn: Protection of a person's private information from unwanted access, collection or use.
entries.translationUz: shaxsiy ma’lumotlar daxlsizligi; ularni nomaqbul olish yoki ishlatishdan himoya qilish
entries.exampleEn: The privacy officer checked how the dataset could expose individual patients.
entries.exampleUz: Shaxsiy ma’lumotlarni himoyalash bo‘yicha xodim ma’lumotlar to‘plami ayrim bemorlarni qanday oshkor qilishi mumkinligini tekshirdi.

entries.definitionEn: Through another step, person or connection, rather than by a direct link.
entries.translationUz: bilvosita; bevosita emas, boshqa bosqich, vosita yoki bog‘lanish orqali
entries.exampleEn: A rare combination of dates and treatments could identify a patient indirectly.
entries.exampleUz: Sana va davolash usullarining kam uchraydigan birikmasi bemorni bilvosita aniqlash imkonini berishi mumkin edi.

entries.definitionEn: Inside the limits of a named area, group or system.
entries.translationUz: ... ichida; ko‘rsatilgan hudud, guruh yoki tizim chegaralari doirasida
entries.exampleEn: The analysis had to remain within a controlled environment.
entries.exampleUz: Tahlil nazorat qilinadigan muhit doirasida qolishi kerak edi.

entries.definitionEn: The person responsible for coordinating and guiding a particular project.
entries.translationUz: loyiha rahbari; muayyan loyihani muvofiqlashtirib boshqaradigan shaxs
entries.exampleEn: The project lead asked who would carry the risks of sharing the data.
entries.exampleUz: Loyiha rahbari ma’lumotlarni ulashish xavflari kimning zimmasiga tushishini so‘radi.

entries.definitionEn: A person or group involved in an arrangement, agreement or dispute.
entries.translationUz: taraf; kelishuv, bitim yoki nizoda ishtirok etuvchi shaxs yoki guruh
entries.exampleEn: Each party faced different risks under the data-sharing agreement.
entries.exampleUz: Ma’lumotlarni ulashish kelishuvida har bir taraf turli xavflarga duch keldi.

entries.definitionEn: The act of making information or data available for others to use or see.
entries.translationUz: e’lon qilish; ma’lumotni boshqalar ko‘rishi yoki ishlatishi uchun ochish
entries.exampleEn: The agreement allowed a limited release of the hospital data.
entries.exampleUz: Kelishuv shifoxona ma’lumotlarini cheklangan tarzda foydalanishga ochishga ruxsat berdi.

entries.definitionEn: A person who examines a proposal, decision or piece of work to assess it.
entries.translationUz: tekshiruvchi; taklif, qaror yoki ishni ko‘rib chiqib baholaydigan shaxs
entries.exampleEn: The reviewers examined whether the access rules had been applied consistently.
entries.exampleUz: Tekshiruvchilar foydalanish qoidalari izchil qo‘llangan-qo‘llanmaganini ko‘rib chiqdi.

entries.definitionEn: A rule, measure or procedure used to manage an activity or keep it within limits.
entries.translationUz: nazorat chorasi; faoliyatni boshqarish yoki cheklash uchun qo‘llanadigan qoida yoki tartib
entries.exampleEn: The hospital checked whether its data-access controls were applied consistently.
entries.exampleUz: Shifoxona ma’lumotlardan foydalanish bo‘yicha nazorat choralari izchil qo‘llanganini tekshirdi.

entries.definitionEn: To prevent particular information from being published or made known.
entries.translationUz: oshkor qilmaslik; muayyan ma’lumotning e’lon qilinishiga yo‘l qo‘ymaslik
entries.exampleEn: The report suppressed very small counts to reduce the risk of identifying patients.
entries.exampleUz: Hisobot bemorlarni aniqlab olish xavfini kamaytirish uchun juda kichik miqdorlarni oshkor qilmadi.

entries.definitionEn: A specialist who examines and cares for cultural objects to protect them from damage or deterioration.
entries.translationUz: konservator; madaniy buyumlarni shikastlanish va yemirilishdan asraydigan mutaxassis
entries.exampleEn: The conservators recorded every repair before treating the textile.
entries.exampleUz: Konservatorlar matoga ishlov berishdan oldin har bir ta’mir izini qayd etdi.

entries.definitionEn: Used in or connected with a formal ceremony.
entries.translationUz: marosimga oid; rasmiy marosimda ishlatiladigan
entries.exampleEn: The museum displayed a ceremonial textile with carefully preserved repairs.
entries.exampleUz: Muzey ta’mir izlari ehtiyotkorlik bilan saqlangan marosim matosini namoyish etdi.

entries.definitionEn: To put something back into a former state, position or condition.
entries.translationUz: avvalgi holatiga qaytarmoq
entries.exampleEn: Returning every thread to its earlier colour could hide the textile's history.
entries.exampleUz: Har bir ipni avvalgi rangiga qaytarish matoning tarixini yashirishi mumkin edi.
usageFrames: return an object to its earlier state
return the fabric to its original colour

entries.definitionEn: A procedure applied to a material object to protect or improve its condition.
entries.translationUz: ishlov; buyumning holatini asrash yoki yaxshilash uchun qo‘llanadigan amaliy chora
entries.exampleEn: The conservation treatment protected the fragile edges without hiding later repairs.
entries.exampleUz: Konservatsion ishlov keyingi ta’mir izlarini yashirmay, nozik chetlarni asradi.

entries.definitionEn: A line or group of stitches sewn into fabric or another material.
entries.translationUz: choklar; mato yoki boshqa materialga tikilgan ip qatorlari
entries.exampleEn: The conservators photographed the stitching before removing it.
entries.exampleUz: Konservatorlar choklarni so‘kib olishdan oldin ularni suratga oldi.

entries.definitionEn: The care and protection of cultural objects to prevent deterioration and preserve their significance.
entries.translationUz: madaniy buyumlarni asrash; ularning yemirilishining oldini olib, ahamiyatini saqlash ishlari
entries.exampleEn: Conservation kept the textile stable while preserving evidence of its later repairs.
entries.exampleUz: Konservatsiya keyingi ta’mir izlarini saqlagan holda matoning holatini barqaror tutdi.

entries.definitionEn: To make an object's condition secure enough to prevent further deterioration.
entries.translationUz: buyumning yanada yemirilishini to‘xtatmoq; holatini barqarorlashtirmoq
entries.exampleEn: The team stabilised the fragile edges instead of replacing the whole textile.
entries.exampleUz: Jamoa butun matoni almashtirish o‘rniga uning nozik chetlarini mustahkamladi.

entries.definitionEn: Not convincing or well supported when used as evidence or reasoning.
entries.translationUz: dalili sust; yetarlicha asoslanmagan yoki ishontirmaydigan
entries.exampleEn: The evidence for the proposed pattern remained weak.
entries.exampleUz: Taklif qilingan naqshni asoslovchi dalillar sustligicha qoldi.

entries.definitionEn: In a way that involves real material things or direct action on them.
entries.translationUz: moddiy buyumning o‘ziga amalda ta’sir qilib; jismoniy jihatdan
entries.exampleEn: Physically conserving the textile differed from imagining its earlier appearance.
entries.exampleUz: Matoning o‘zini amalda asrash uning avvalgi ko‘rinishini tasavvur qilishdan farq qilardi.

entries.definitionEn: To make a photographic image of someone or something using a camera.
entries.translationUz: suratga olmoq; kamera yordamida fotografik tasvir yaratmoq
entries.exampleEn: The conservators photographed the textile before removing any stitching.
entries.exampleUz: Konservatorlar birorta chokni so‘kib olishdan oldin matoni suratga oldi.

entries.definitionEn: A long low area of land through which a river flows.
entries.translationUz: daryo vodiysi; daryo oqib o‘tadigan uzun pasttekis hudud
entries.exampleEn: The river-valley council reviewed insurance costs after repeated floods.
entries.exampleUz: Daryo vodiysi kengashi takroriy toshqinlardan so‘ng sug‘urta xarajatlarini qayta ko‘rib chiqdi.

entries.definitionEn: To arrange for an agreement or document to remain in force for another period.
entries.translationUz: amal qilish muddatini uzaytirmoq; kelishuvni yana bir davr uchun davom ettirmoq
entries.exampleEn: Some households could not renew their insurance policies.
entries.exampleUz: Ayrim xonadonlar sug‘urta polislarining amal qilish muddatini uzaytira olmadi.

entries.definitionEn: Too expensive for the relevant person or group to be able to pay for.
entries.translationUz: qurbi yetmaydigan darajada qimmat; to‘lash imkoni bo‘lmagan
entries.exampleEn: More precise pricing could make flood cover unaffordable for some households.
entries.exampleUz: Narxni aniqroq hisoblash ayrim xonadonlar uchun toshqindan sug‘urtalanishni qurbi yetmaydigan darajada qimmatlashtirishi mumkin edi.

entries.definitionEn: The extent to which people can pay a cost with the money available to them.
entries.translationUz: to‘lashga qurbi yetishi; narxni mavjud mablag‘ bilan qoplay olish darajasi
entries.exampleEn: The shared fund addressed affordability without removing the flood hazard.
entries.exampleUz: Umumiy jamg‘arma toshqin xavfini yo‘qotmay, to‘lovga qurbi yetish masalasini hal qilardi.

entries.definitionEn: Concerning an individual building or property rather than a whole neighbourhood or region.
entries.translationUz: alohida bino yoki mulk darajasidagi; butun hududga emas, muayyan uyga tegishli
entries.exampleEn: The model did not consistently recognise property-level flood safeguards.
entries.exampleUz: Model alohida uylar darajasidagi toshqindan himoya choralarini doim ham hisobga olmadi.

entries.definitionEn: A building or buildings together with the land belonging to them.
entries.translationUz: ko‘chmas mulk; bino va unga tegishli yer
entries.exampleEn: Some properties near the river benefited from outdated risk assumptions.
entries.exampleUz: Daryo yaqinidagi ayrim ko‘chmas mulklar eskirgan xavf taxminlari tufayli yengillikdan foydalandi.

entries.definitionEn: A particular scale or unit at which an activity or analysis is organised.
entries.translationUz: daraja; faoliyat yoki tahlil amalga oshiriladigan ko‘lam yoki birlik
entries.exampleEn: The analyst recommended estimating flood risk at street level.
entries.exampleUz: Tahlilchi toshqin xavfini ko‘cha darajasida hisoblashni tavsiya qildi.
usageFrames: analyse risk at a local level

entries.definitionEn: To remain true, valid or applicable.
entries.translationUz: to‘g‘ri yoki asosli bo‘lib qolmoq; amal qilmoq
entries.exampleEn: Some earlier assumptions no longer held after the flood maps changed.
entries.exampleUz: Toshqin xaritalari o‘zgargach, ayrim avvalgi taxminlar endi asosli bo‘lmay qoldi.
usageFrames: a rule holds in this case

entries.definitionEn: Seeking priority over one another, often because the same resources cannot fully meet all of them.
entries.translationUz: o‘zaro ustuvorlik uchun kurashayotgan; bir-biriga zid talablar qo‘yayotgan
entries.exampleEn: The discrepancy produced competing demands for fairness.
entries.exampleUz: Tafovut adolatlilikka oid bir-biriga zid talablarni yuzaga keltirdi.

entries.definitionEn: Involving a greater than usual possibility of harm or loss.
entries.translationUz: xavfi yuqori; odatdagidan ko‘proq zarar ehtimoli bor
entries.exampleEn: The fund would help households in high-risk homes.
entries.exampleUz: Jamg‘arma xavfi yuqori uylardagi xonadonlarga yordam berardi.

entries.definitionEn: Of the kind previously mentioned or described.
entries.translationUz: bunday; avval aytilgan turdagi
entries.exampleEn: Such a fund would help with premiums but would not stop flooding.
entries.exampleUz: Bunday jamg‘arma sug‘urta badallariga yordam berardi, ammo toshqinni to‘xtatmasdi.

entries.definitionEn: Used to introduce an example or examples of the kind of thing being discussed.
entries.translationUz: masalan; ... kabi
entries.exampleEn: Some repairs, such as raised entrances, protected individual homes.
entries.exampleUz: Ayrim ta’mirlar, masalan, balandlatilgan kirish joylari alohida uylarni himoya qildi.

entries.definitionEn: An operation that combines two or more items into a single item.
entries.translationUz: birlashtirish amali; ikki yoki undan ko‘p elementni bitta elementga qo‘shish
entries.exampleEn: The merge put two locally distinct words into a single archive entry.
entries.exampleUz: Birlashtirish amali mahalliy ma’nolari farqli ikki so‘zni bitta arxiv yozuviga qo‘shdi.

entries.definitionEn: The particular sequence of letters used to write a word.
entries.translationUz: so‘zning yozilishi; uni yozishda ishlatiladigan harflar ketma-ketligi
entries.exampleEn: The two words shared a similar spelling but had different meanings.
entries.exampleUz: Ikki so‘zning yozilishi o‘xshash, ammo ma’nolari turlicha edi.

entries.definitionEn: A person who supplies information, work or other resources to help a shared project.
entries.translationUz: hissa qo‘shuvchi; umumiy loyiha uchun ma’lumot, mehnat yoki boshqa yordam beradigan shaxs
entries.exampleEn: Contributors could check how their recorded words were represented.
entries.exampleUz: Hissa qo‘shganlar yozib olingan so‘zlari qanday ifodalanganini tekshira olardi.

entries.definitionEn: A short audio recording or an excerpt from a longer sound recording.
entries.translationUz: qisqa audio parcha; uzunroq ovoz yozuvidan olingan qism
entries.exampleEn: Audio clips with restricted consent were not available in public downloads.
entries.exampleUz: Foydalanish roziligi cheklangan audio parchalar ochiq yuklab olish uchun berilmadi.

entries.definitionEn: Openness about how work is done or decisions are made, allowing others to examine them.
entries.translationUz: shaffoflik; ish va qarorlar qanday amalga oshirilganini ochiq ko‘rsatish
entries.exampleEn: Keeping earlier versions supported scholarly transparency.
entries.exampleUz: Avvalgi nusxalarni saqlash ilmiy shaffoflikka xizmat qildi.

entries.definitionEn: An activity undertaken for a particular purpose.
entries.translationUz: muayyan maqsadda bajariladigan ish yoki faoliyat
entries.exampleEn: The revision became an explicit process rather than an invisible exercise in standardisation.
entries.exampleUz: Qayta ko‘rib chiqish yashirin standartlashtirish ishi emas, ochiq jarayonga aylandi.

entries.definitionEn: To include or deal with something within the scope of a report, agreement, rule or permission.
entries.translationUz: qamrab olmoq; hisobot, kelishuv, qoida yoki ruxsatning doirasiga kiritmoq
entries.exampleEn: The original consent did not cover every possible future use.
entries.exampleUz: Dastlabki rozilik kelajakdagi barcha foydalanish usullarini qamrab olmasdi.
usageFrames: a report covers the whole operation

entries.definitionEn: Information or variation treated as irrelevant because it obscures a useful signal or pattern.
entries.translationUz: axborotdagi shovqin; foydali signal yoki qonuniyatni berkitadigan ahamiyatsiz ma’lumot yoki tafovut
entries.exampleEn: Treating a meaningful distinction as noise would distort the archive.
entries.exampleUz: Mazmunli farqni axborot shovqini deb hisoblash arxiv mazmunini buzardi.

entries.definitionEn: Without announcing or drawing attention to an action or change.
entries.translationUz: bildirmasdan; amalga oshirilgan ish yoki o‘zgarishga e’tibor qaratmasdan
entries.exampleEn: The editors marked uncertain meanings instead of silently choosing one.
entries.exampleUz: Muharrirlar bir ma’noni bildirmay tanlash o‘rniga, noaniq ma’nolarni belgiladi.

entries.definitionEn: Correctness and fidelity to the facts or the original material.
entries.translationUz: aniqlik; faktlar yoki asl materialni xatosiz, to‘g‘ri ifodalash
entries.exampleEn: Accuracy required the editors to preserve distinctions they did not yet fully understand.
entries.exampleUz: Aniqlik muharrirlardan hali to‘liq tushunmagan farqlarni ham saqlashni talab qildi.
usageFrames: protect the accuracy of a record

entries.definitionEn: Presented as the main or most noticeable figure in a report.
entries.translationUz: hisobotda asosiy qilib ko‘rsatilgan, eng ko‘zga tashlanadigan
entries.exampleEn: Headline counts were paired with measures of lasting employment.
entries.exampleUz: Hisobotdagi asosiy sonlar ishda uzoq qolish ko‘rsatkichlari bilan birga berildi.

entries.definitionEn: The business sector providing accommodation, food, drink and related services to guests.
entries.translationUz: mehmonxona, restoran va mehmonlarga xizmat ko‘rsatish sohasi
entries.exampleEn: Temporary hospitality placements often ended with another visit to the job centre.
entries.exampleUz: Mehmonxona va restoran sohasidagi vaqtinchalik ishlar ko‘pincha bandlik markaziga qayta murojaat qilish bilan tugardi.

entries.definitionEn: A person or organisation that supplies money to support an activity or organisation.
entries.translationUz: mablag‘ ajratuvchi shaxs yoki tashkilot
entries.exampleEn: Funders received reports that distinguished temporary jobs from sustained employment.
entries.exampleUz: Mablag‘ ajratuvchilar vaqtinchalik va uzoq davom etadigan ishlarni ajratib ko‘rsatgan hisobotlarni oldi.

entries.definitionEn: The process or result of helping a person obtain a job.
entries.translationUz: ishga joylashtirish; kishiga ish topishda yordam berish yoki buning natijasi
entries.exampleEn: A placement was not counted as lasting success merely because a job had been offered.
entries.exampleUz: Faqat ish taklif qilingani uchun ishga joylashtirish uzoq muddatli muvaffaqiyat deb hisoblanmadi.

entries.definitionEn: The length of a period needed or taken for an activity.
entries.translationUz: biror ishga kerak bo‘lgan yoki sarflangan vaqt davomiyligi
entries.exampleEn: The service reduced the time needed to place applicants in jobs.
entries.exampleUz: Xizmat murojaatchilarni ishga joylashtirishga ketadigan vaqtni qisqartirdi.
usageFrames: the time needed for a task

entries.definitionEn: A weakness or restriction that reduces how useful or complete something is.
entries.translationUz: foydalilik yoki to‘liqlikni kamaytiradigan kamchilik, cheklangan jihat
entries.exampleEn: The omission exposed a limitation of placement-based reporting.
entries.exampleUz: Bu ma’lumotning tushirib qoldirilgani ishga joylashtirishga asoslangan hisobotning kamchiligini ko‘rsatdi.

entries.definitionEn: Relating to the supply of workers and the availability of jobs.
entries.translationUz: mehnat bozoriga, ishchi kuchi va mavjud ish o‘rinlariga oid
entries.exampleEn: The apparent improvement concealed a complicated labour-market reality.
entries.exampleUz: Ko‘zga ko‘ringan yaxshilanish mehnat bozoridagi murakkab vaziyatni yashirardi.

entries.definitionEn: Lasting for a single day.
entries.translationUz: bir kunlik; bir kun davom etadigan
entries.exampleEn: One-day contracts were counted as successful placements.
entries.exampleUz: Bir kunlik shartnomalar muvaffaqiyatli ishga joylashtirish deb hisoblangan.

entries.definitionEn: Extending further into the future rather than considering only immediate results.
entries.translationUz: uzoqroq muddatdagi; faqat darhol emas, keyingi davrdagi natijalarga oid
entries.exampleEn: Longer-term results differed between employment sectors.
entries.exampleUz: Uzoqroq muddatdagi natijalar ish sohalariga qarab farq qilardi.

entries.definitionEn: Based on records of people being helped into jobs.
entries.translationUz: ishga joylashtirish yozuvlari yoki natijalariga asoslangan
entries.exampleEn: Placement-based reporting missed people who later found jobs independently.
entries.exampleUz: Ishga joylashtirishga asoslangan hisobot keyinchalik mustaqil ish topganlarni hisobga olmasdi.

entries.definitionEn: A long, narrow area or zone that differs from its surroundings.
entries.translationUz: atrofidan ajralib turadigan uzun, ensiz hudud yoki yo‘lak
entries.exampleEn: Narrow bands of heavy rain were hidden by the coarse model.
entries.exampleUz: Keng katakli model kuchli yomg‘ir yog‘adigan ensiz yo‘laklarni ko‘rsata olmadi.

entries.definitionEn: One of the spatial units into which an area is divided for calculations in a numerical model.
entries.translationUz: hisoblash katagi; sonli modelda hudud bo‘linadigan qismlardan biri
entries.exampleEn: A large grid cell could hide a narrow band of heavy rain.
entries.exampleUz: Katta hisoblash katagi kuchli yomg‘ir yog‘adigan ensiz yo‘lakni yashirib qolishi mumkin edi.

entries.definitionEn: To test something by using it in practice to judge how well it works.
entries.translationUz: amaliyotda sinab ko‘rmoq; qanday ishlashini tekshirmoq
entries.exampleEn: The team trialled forecasts that gave ranges rather than a single time.
entries.exampleUz: Guruh bitta vaqt o‘rniga oraliq ko‘rsatadigan prognozlarni amaliyotda sinadi.

entries.definitionEn: The values or amounts lying between a lower and an upper limit.
entries.translationUz: oraliq; quyi va yuqori chegara orasidagi qiymatlar
entries.exampleEn: The forecast gave a probability range instead of a single value.
entries.exampleUz: Prognoz bitta qiymat o‘rniga ehtimollar oralig‘ini berdi.

entries.definitionEn: Expressed using an interval of possible values instead of one exact value.
entries.translationUz: bitta aniq qiymat o‘rniga ehtimoliy qiymatlar oralig‘i bilan berilgan
entries.exampleEn: A range-based forecast made the existing uncertainty visible.
entries.exampleUz: Oraliq bilan berilgan prognoz mavjud noaniqlikni ochiq ko‘rsatdi.

entries.definitionEn: An open urban area with vegetation, used or planned for recreation or other outdoor activities.
entries.translationUz: shahardagi ko‘kalamzor ochiq hudud; sayr va boshqa ochiq havodagi mashg‘ulotlar joyi
entries.exampleEn: The redevelopment proposal promised green space beside new housing.
entries.exampleUz: Qayta qurish taklifida yangi uylar yonida ko‘kalamzor hudud va’da qilingan edi.

entries.definitionEn: An individual dwelling, such as an apartment within a larger building or development.
entries.translationUz: alohida turar joy; masalan, binodagi bitta xonadon
entries.exampleEn: Residents disagreed about how many affordable units would be enough.
entries.exampleUz: Aholi arzon xonadonlarning nechtasi yetarli bo‘lishi haqida kelisha olmadi.

entries.definitionEn: Concerning the subject of a disagreement, discussion or question.
entries.translationUz: ... masalasida; bahs yoki muhokama mavzusini bildiradi
entries.exampleEn: Residents remained divided over the number of affordable homes.
entries.exampleUz: Aholi arzon uylar soni masalasida hamon kelisha olmadi.

entries.definitionEn: To monitor and keep a record of changes, progress or performance over time.
entries.translationUz: kuzatib, qayd etib bormoq; o‘zgarish yoki bajarilishni vaqt davomida tekshirmoq
entries.exampleEn: A public register would track the housing promises after completion.
entries.exampleUz: Qurilish tugagach, ochiq reyestr uy-joy bo‘yicha va’dalarning bajarilishini kuzatib borardi.

entries.definitionEn: Having opposing opinions and unable to agree on an issue.
entries.translationUz: fikri bo‘lingan; bir masalada qarama-qarshi fikrda bo‘lib, kelisha olmayotgan
entries.exampleEn: Residents remained divided over the revised housing proposal.
entries.exampleUz: Aholi uy-joy bo‘yicha yangilangan taklif yuzasidan hamon kelisha olmadi.

entries.definitionEn: Specific and definite, referring to actual actions or details rather than a general idea.
entries.translationUz: aniq va amaliy; umumiy g‘oya emas, muayyan ish yoki tafsilotga oid
entries.exampleEn: The debate improved when people discussed concrete commitments.
entries.exampleUz: Odamlar aniq majburiyatlarni muhokama qilgach, bahs samaraliroq bo‘ldi.

entries.definitionEn: Priced below the usual market level for comparable goods or property.
entries.translationUz: bozordagi odatiy narxdan past
entries.exampleEn: The review explored below-market housing alongside relocation protections.
entries.exampleUz: Tekshiruvda ko‘chirishdan himoya choralari bilan birga bozor narxidan arzon uy-joy imkoniyati ko‘rib chiqildi.

entries.definitionEn: A measure, right or arrangement intended to guard against harm or disadvantage.
entries.translationUz: himoya chorasi yoki huquqi; zarar va noqulaylikdan saqlashga qaratilgan tartib
entries.exampleEn: Tenants wanted protections that would survive a change in ownership.
entries.exampleUz: Ijarachilar mulkdor almashganda ham amal qiladigan himoya choralarini xohladi.

entries.definitionEn: A duty or action that a person or organisation is required to fulfil.
entries.translationUz: bajarilishi shart bo‘lgan vazifa yoki majburiyat
entries.exampleEn: The developer explained which obligations would pass to future owners.
entries.exampleUz: Quruvchi qaysi majburiyatlar kelajakdagi mulkdorlarga o‘tishini tushuntirdi.

entries.definitionEn: A promise or agreement to take a particular action.
entries.translationUz: muayyan ishni bajarish haqidagi va’da yoki kelishuv
entries.exampleEn: Concrete commitments made the redevelopment proposal easier to evaluate.
entries.exampleUz: Aniq va’dalar qayta qurish taklifini baholashni osonlashtirdi.

entries.definitionEn: A person involved in organised efforts to change a policy, practice or condition in society.
entries.translationUz: jamoatchilik faoli; jamiyatdagi qoida yoki vaziyatni o‘zgartirishga intiluvchi shaxs
entries.exampleEn: Local campaigners questioned whether the emissions chart covered outsourced deliveries.
entries.exampleUz: Mahalliy faollar chiqindilar jadvali tashqi pudratchilar yetkazuvlarini ham qamrab olganini so‘roq qildi.

entries.definitionEn: A person who formally checks an organisation’s records, activities or reporting for accuracy and compliance.
entries.translationUz: auditor; tashkilot yozuvlari, faoliyati yoki hisobotini rasman tekshiruvchi shaxs
entries.exampleEn: The auditor identified the electricity mix as an important uncertainty.
entries.exampleUz: Auditor elektr energiyasi manbalari tarkibini muhim noaniqlik sifatida ko‘rsatdi.

entries.definitionEn: A combination of different elements and the proportions in which they occur.
entries.translationUz: tarkib; turli qismlar va ularning ulushlaridan iborat birikma
entries.exampleEn: The electricity mix affected the total emissions estimate.
entries.exampleUz: Elektr energiyasi manbalari tarkibi jami chiqindilar bahosiga ta’sir qildi.

entries.definitionEn: Containing both favourable and unfavourable elements or results.
entries.translationUz: ijobiy va salbiy jihatlari aralash; bir xil bo‘lmagan natijali
entries.exampleEn: Managers feared that a mixed result would be interpreted as failure.
entries.exampleUz: Rahbarlar ijobiy va salbiy jihatlari bor natija muvaffaqiyatsizlik deb talqin qilinishidan qo‘rqdi.

entries.definitionEn: In combination, so as to form a joint whole or total.
entries.translationUz: birga qo‘shib; yagona butun yoki jami hosil qiladigan tarzda
entries.exampleEn: Uncertain estimates were added together without showing their assumptions.
entries.exampleUz: Noaniq baholar ularning farazlari ko‘rsatilmay birga qo‘shilgan edi.

entries.definitionEn: To draw someone’s attention to a fact or detail by mentioning it.
entries.translationUz: biror fakt yoki tafsilotni aytib, unga e’tibor qaratmoq
entries.exampleEn: The organiser pointed out that residents were not simply opposing the park.
entries.exampleUz: Tashkilotchi aholi shunchaki parkka qarshi chiqmayotganini ta’kidladi.

entries.definitionEn: A prepared written text that someone follows when speaking or conducting an activity.
entries.translationUz: oldindan tayyorlangan matn; gapirish yoki mashg‘ulotni olib borishda o‘qib boriladigan yozuv
entries.exampleEn: Some examiners read fixed scripts instead of adapting their questions.
entries.exampleUz: Ayrim imtihon oluvchilar savollarni moslashtirish o‘rniga oldindan tayyorlangan matnlarni o‘qidi.

entries.definitionEn: The way information or ideas are expressed and organised for an audience.
entries.translationUz: ma’lumot yoki fikrlarni tinglovchi yoxud o‘quvchiga ifodalash va tartiblab berish usuli
entries.exampleEn: A fluent presentation could hide weak reasoning in an oral examination.
entries.exampleUz: Og‘zaki imtihonda ravon ifodalash sust asoslangan fikrni yashirib qolishi mumkin edi.

entries.definitionEn: A repeated test used to check whether something is safe, effective or working correctly.
entries.translationUz: qayta sinov; xavfsizlik yoki ishlashni yana tekshirish
entries.exampleEn: One successful retest could not establish safety under all unfamiliar conditions.
entries.exampleUz: Bitta muvaffaqiyatli qayta sinov barcha notanish sharoitlarda xavfsizlikni isbotlay olmasdi.

entries.definitionEn: The person responsible for guiding and coordinating safety work in a project or organisation.
entries.translationUz: xavfsizlik ishlari rahbari; xavfsizlikni ta’minlash ishlarini boshqaruvchi shaxs
entries.exampleEn: The safety lead requested tests with unexpected materials.
entries.exampleUz: Xavfsizlik ishlari rahbari kutilmagan materiallar bilan sinovlar o‘tkazishni so‘radi.

entries.definitionEn: The process of improving a learning system by using examples or experience to adjust how it works.
entries.translationUz: tizimni o‘qitish; misollar yoki tajriba orqali uning ishlashini moslashtirish jarayoni
entries.exampleEn: Training on only the failed examples could leave other obstacles unrecognised.
entries.exampleUz: Faqat nosozlik yuz bergan misollar bilan o‘qitish boshqa to‘siqlarni aniqlamay qolishga olib kelishi mumkin edi.

entries.definitionEn: A system’s estimate of how reliable a detection or prediction is.
entries.translationUz: tizimning aniqlash yoki bashorat natijasiga bergan ishonchlilik bahosi
entries.exampleEn: The robot slowed down when sensor confidence fell.
entries.exampleUz: Datchik natijasining ishonchlilik bahosi pasayganda robot sekinlashdi.

entries.definitionEn: The process of putting a system or piece of technology into practical use.
entries.translationUz: tizim yoki texnologiyani amaliy foydalanishga joriy etish
entries.exampleEn: The manufacturer delayed wider deployment until the safety trials were complete.
entries.exampleUz: Ishlab chiqaruvchi xavfsizlik sinovlari tugaguncha kengroq joriy etishni kechiktirdi.

entries.definitionEn: A paper or electronic document with designated spaces for entering information.
entries.translationUz: ma’lumot kiritish uchun joylari belgilangan qog‘oz yoki elektron shakl
entries.exampleEn: Workers reported near misses through a confidential form.
entries.exampleUz: Ishchilar xavfli holatga oz qolgan voqealarni maxfiy shakl orqali xabar qildi.

entries.definitionEn: To discover the presence of something through observation, instruments or other evidence.
entries.translationUz: kuzatish, asbob yoki boshqa dalil yordamida biror narsaning borligini aniqlamoq
entries.exampleEn: Some obstacles were detected too late by the robot’s sensors.
entries.exampleUz: Robot datchiklari ayrim to‘siqlarni juda kech aniqladi.

entries.definitionEn: To adjust a learning system’s behaviour by using examples or experience.
entries.translationUz: tizimni o‘qitmoq; misollar yoki tajriba orqali uning ishlashini moslashtirmoq
entries.exampleEn: Engineers avoided training the robot solely on the materials from the failed demonstration.
entries.exampleUz: Muhandislar robotni faqat muvaffaqiyatsiz namoyishda uchragan materiallar bilan o‘qitishdan tiyildi.
usageFrames: train a model on varied examples

entries.definitionEn: Naturally occurring in a particular region rather than introduced from elsewhere.
entries.translationUz: mahalliy, tub; boshqa joydan olib kelinmay, shu hududda tabiiy o‘sadigan yoki yashaydigan
entries.exampleEn: Native trees were already growing among the fallen trunks.
entries.exampleUz: Qulagan tanalar orasida mahalliy daraxtlar allaqachon o‘sayotgan edi.

entries.definitionEn: To interfere with a process or environment so that its normal state or development changes.
entries.translationUz: jarayon yoki muhitga xalaqit bermoq, uning tabiiy rivojlanishini o‘zgartirmoq
entries.exampleEn: Planting in unsuitable places could disturb natural woodland recovery.
entries.exampleUz: Noto‘g‘ri joylarga ekish o‘rmonning tabiiy tiklanishiga xalaqit berishi mumkin edi.

entries.definitionEn: An event or action that interrupts or alters the state or development of an environment or process.
entries.translationUz: muhit yoki jarayon holati va rivojlanishiga ta’sir qilib, uni o‘zgartiradigan hodisa yoki harakat
entries.exampleEn: Extra planting in shaded areas could cause further disturbance.
entries.exampleUz: Soyali hududlarda qo‘shimcha ekish muhitga yana ta’sir qilib, uni o‘zgartirishi mumkin edi.

entries.definitionEn: To direct an action or effort towards a particular person, thing or problem.
entries.translationUz: muayyan shaxs, narsa yoki muammoga qarshi yoxud unga qaratib chora ko‘rmoq
entries.exampleEn: Ecologists targeted invasive plants instead of planting trees everywhere.
entries.exampleUz: Ekologlar hamma joyga daraxt ekish o‘rniga, mahalliy muhitga zarar yetkazadigan o‘simliklarga qarshi choralarni yo‘naltirdi.
usageFrames: target the main source of harm
